title: finding(plugin-map): the legacy `filter.map` warning names a default `name` title field that objectui#5953 removed
body:
Found while compiling `packages/plugin-map/README.md`'s snippets for objectui#5174 (batch 35). Filed unassigned and NOT touched there — that batch may not edit `packages/plugin-map/src/**`.

## What

`warnOnLegacyFilterMapConfig()` in `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` warns when a map's configuration is stashed under the legacy `filter.map` shape (objectui#4034). Its message tells the reader which field names the map fell back to:

> `filter.map` is no longer read as map configuration, so this map is rendering with the DEFAULT field names (`latitude` / `longitude` / `name`).

Those are not the defaults. `getMapConfig()`'s default branch, in the same file, returns:

- `latitudeField: 'latitude'`
- `longitudeField: 'longitude'`
- `locationField: 'location'`
- `descriptionField: 'description'`
- **no `titleField` at all**, deliberately, with an eight-line comment citing objectui#5953: a forged `'name'` binding outranks the object's own declared `nameField` at step 0 of `getRecordDisplayName`, so an ABSENT binding must stay absent and let that resolver decide.

So the warning names one default that objectui#5953 removed on purpose (`name`), and omits two that exist (`location`, `description`).

## Why it matters

This is the diagnostic a reader gets at exactly the moment they are confused about which field names the map is reading — the message exists because the alternative was "dropping the author's markers without a trace". Sending them to look for a `name` field is the one wrong answer that shape of confusion can produce: the map falls back to `location` (which the message never mentions), and the marker TITLE comes from the record-title precedence, not from any field name at all.

It also reads as a claim about the code that is now false, next to a comment block in the same file that explains at length why it is false — so the next reader has to work out which of the two to believe.

## Reachability

Dev-mode only (`isDev()` guard), warn-once per distinct schema. Nothing renders differently; the cost is entirely in what the message teaches. Not a runtime defect.

## Suggested repair

One string. Restate the branch the code actually takes: `latitude` / `longitude` / `location` / `description`, and say that the marker title is resolved by `getRecordDisplayName` rather than by a default field name. `packages/plugin-map/README.md` already documents it that way (the "The `map` block" section), so the README and the warning would then agree.

Refs: objectui#5174, objectui#4034, objectui#5953.

Filed by an os-dev agent seat while working objectui#5174 batch 35; session reference `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`.
